name: Slider
summary: One number on a range, picked by dragging a thumb or with the arrow keys.
useWhen: A value where the rough position matters more than the exact number: volume, opacity, zoom
A bounded number with a small step that people tune while watching the result
A setting with a few named stops, shown as marks
avoidWhen: An exact number that people know and want to type
A low and a high value, such as a price range
A choice among a few named options with no order between them

size.description: Track 2, 4 and 6 px thick, thumb 12, 16 and 24 px in a target of 24 px, 24 px and the lg control height.

tone.description: The range fill and the thumb: the primary color the style uses on a surface.

onValueChange.description: Called on every change, while dragging too.

onValueCommit.description: Called once when a drag ends or a key changes the value. Save here.

step.description: Arrows move one step; PageUp and PageDown move ten.

label.description: Visible name above the track. Names the thumb through aria-labelledby. Without it, pass aria-label.

showValue.description: Shows the formatted value at the end of the label row. Default true when there is a label.

unit.description: A unit after the number, in the value text and aria-valuetext: %, px, SAR.

formatOptions.description: Intl.NumberFormat options for the value text. Digits are always Western.

formatValue.description: Full control of the value text, aria-valuetext included.

marks.description: Ticks under the track: numbers, or { value, label } objects.

invalid.description: A danger tint on the track and aria-invalid on the thumb. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

disabled.description: Inside a Field it follows the Field.

rootProps.description: Props for the root element. className and style also go to the root.

a11y.role: slider, on the thumb (a Radix span), with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext.
a11y.focus: The thumb is the one tab stop. Focus shows the glow and a 2px ring around the drawn thumb.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the thumb, and on to the next control
keys.ArrowRight, ArrowUp: Raise the value by one step. In right to left text ArrowLeft raises it.
keys.ArrowLeft, ArrowDown: Lower the value by one step. In right to left text ArrowRight lowers it.
keys.PageUp, PageDown: Raise or lower the value by ten steps
keys.Shift+ArrowRight: Moves by ten steps, as PageUp
keys.Home, End: Move to the minimum or the maximum

a11y.announce: Name from the label (or aria-label), then aria-valuetext: the formatted value with its unit, such as 40%. The visible value is aria-hidden, so it is not read twice.
notes: Every drag has the key path above (WCAG 2.5.7).
The thumb is a target of at least 24px at every size (the lg control height at lg): the drawn circle is its content box.
Values use Western digits in every language. formatSliderValue is a stand in until packages/shared/src/number.ts lands.
Marks are aria-hidden: they repeat what aria-valuetext says. A vertical slider shows no marks.
Rest props (name, min, max, step) go to the Radix slider root; the ref goes to the thumb.
Inside a Field with a label and no label of its own, the thumb is named by the Field label through aria-labelledby.
A label that is not a native label: the thumb is not a form element, so the label is tied with aria-labelledby.

en.label: A noun in sentence case: Opacity. The unit goes in unit, not in the label.
en.unit: A symbol or a short unit: %, px, SAR.
en.marks: Only the values people aim for. Not every step.

ar.label: اسم بدون تشكيل: الشفافية
ar.unit: الأرقام إنجليزية دايم، والوحدة بعد الرقم: 12,500 ريال

styles.studio: A thin overlay track, the range and thumb in the bright text color
styles.desk: The same track, the range and thumb in the yellow primary (a darker gold in Desk Light)

mistakes.wrong: A slider for an exact number such as a price
mistakes.right: A NumberField, or a Slider with a NumberField beside it

mistakes.wrong: aria-valuetext left out, so 40 is read with no unit
mistakes.right: The unit prop, which sets aria-valuetext

mistakes.wrong: Saving on every onValueChange while dragging
Two Sliders for a low and a high value
